title: Glossary Primitive
description: Domain language registry. A glossary is a collection of terms, each with a definition, relationships to other terms, code references, and ADR cross-references. Lives within a CONTEXT.md file but exposes structured operations.

name.description: Canonical term. PascalCase for entities, camelCase for properties.

definition.description: One-sentence definition. Must disambiguate from sibling terms.

target.description: Canonical name of the related term.

codeReferences.description: file:line references where this term appears in code.

adrReferences.description: ADR filenames that bear on this term.

CreateTerm.description: Add a new term to the glossary. Fails if name already exists.

RefineTerm.description: Update definition, relationships, or references of an existing term.

DeprecateTerm.description: Mark a term as deprecated, with migration guidance.
DeprecateTerm.input: { name: string, replacedBy: string, reason: string }

ResolveTerm.description: Look up a term by name. Returns null if not found.

FindCollisions.description: Check if a proposed term collides with existing terms.
FindCollisions.output: array of termSchema (terms that are exact or fuzzy matches)

storageTarget.description: Glossary data lives in CONTEXT.md or UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md files, encoded as markdown with a structured glossary section. The primitive defines the schema; the file is the storage.
storageTarget.format: Markdown with ### Glossary section containing term entries
